attributes.name: Burst of Glory
attributes.powers: Display this card when a character at your location encounters a bane. While displayed, add 1d6 to checks to defeat by characters at your location, and each other character that ends his turn at your location may recharge a random card from his discard pile.
attributes.recharge: At the end of your turn, if you do not have the Divine skill, banish this card; otherwise, discard it, or you may succeed a Divine 15 check to recharge it instead.
